title: kate-ui: wrap long lines and move by visual rows
summary: A View menu item toggles View::dynamic_wrap. When it is on, a line that is wider than the editor wraps at the column count from layout::visual_row_count, and Up and Down move by one visual row with layout::visual_step and Command::MoveTo. The caret and the selections paint on the wrapped rows.

lane.reason: A Cursor local agent on the owner Mac codes this packet. session.rs imports GPUI, the crate builds only on macOS, and the owner looks at the window after the change.

definitions.definition:
// gpui::actions!(kate_ui, [...]) declares these unit structs.
pub struct ToggleDynamicWrap;

/// Number of columns that fit in the editor width.
fn wrap_columns(editor_width: Pixels, column_width: Pixels) -> u32

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: wrap_columns divides the width by the column width and floors it, with a minimum of 1. When view.dynamic_wrap is on, the layout splits each line into visual_row_count rows of wrap_columns and paints each row at its own y. Up and Down call layout::visual_step with the display column and send MoveTo for the new offset; when dynamic_wrap is off the key path stays Command::Move. ToggleDynamicWrap flips view.dynamic_wrap on the active view and is in the View menu as Dynamic Word Wrap. The test wrap_columns_floors_the_width asserts wrap_columns(px(100.0), px(8.0)) is 12 and wrap_columns(px(4.0), px(8.0)) is 1. The owner turns wrap on in a file with a long line.
